summary: Split out of the MPI-598 handoff at Fabio's prompting. The outpaint deprecation had been recorded as a constraint inside a handoff scoped to Klein 9B wiring, where nobody would have acted on it. The real content is that flow_character_sheet.json #708 is a second consumer with nothing to do with inpainting, so the weight cannot leave R2 until that shipped flow has its own answer - and even then the dep entry must survive, marked deprecated, or the orphan sweep goes blind and strands the file on existing users' disks.

Consumer table was STALE - re-verified by grep 2026-08-23: klein_t2i.json (node 259 gone), its raw template and klein_9b_t2i are ALL already clean. flow_character_sheet #708 is the ONLY consumer left, so this deprecation is one flow away from done. Fabio also settled what the Character Sheet gets instead: NOTHING - the outpaint LoRA was a workaround for inpainting and LanPaint replaced the workaround, so there is no substitute weight to find. That branch is simply the last graph in the repo still on the pre-LanPaint recipe (no LanPaint node, outpaint LoRA #708, green plate #716). Work = re-author it onto LanPaint copying flow_scribble_object blend phase; #708, #716 and #713 go with it, and loraDeps.js second-consumer comment gets healed. MPI-610 is blocked on this and edits the same nodes.

Handoff d02f766e for the NEXT session: run MPI-603, then MPI-610 (Fabios order). MPI-603 is now small and fully specified - re-author flow_character_sheets head-removal branch onto LanPaint (copying flow_scribble_objects blend phase), which deletes node 708 (outpaint LoRA), 716 (green plate) and 713, then heal the klein-lora-outpaint comment in loraDeps.js that has been blocking the authorised R2/HF delete. MPI-608 is confirmed DONE (e0173e5d, live-checked) so MPI-610s dependency on it is satisfied; 603 and 610 edit the same nodes and are not parallel-safe.
